title: Silas and the Summer
author: Mara Nakamura
blurb: Orsen Fairweather, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
